classification_reason: 30 simultaneous writes over 10 rounds: exactly one per round committed, the other two were refused STALE_SNAPSHOT (exit 3, retryable). No lost, duplicated or partial write: 10 ok = 10 receipts = 7 inbox files + 3 stage updates, no journal, validator clean. Losers re-sealed on the fresh snapshot with the same key committed. 24 batch reads raced against 12 writes showed no torn state. Friction: one global snapshot guard serializes even unrelated writes, so two thirds of concurrent writes need a reload plus a recomputed approval.

consumer.goal: Start two capture.create and one stage.progress.update at the same moment, 10 rounds, and check for conflicts, lost or duplicated writes
consumer.first_action: los plan-edit-context unit-os-l02 --stage-id stage-os-l02-02-proportional-share (snapshot + revisions for the round)
commands: per round: plan-edit-context (guards); seal 3 envelopes on one snapshot; spawn 3 × `los capability …` back-to-back (Python Popen, equivalent to `&` in one shell line); wait
integrity check: inbox files vs ok responses, receipts vs ok transaction ids, .inflight, validate
round-10 losers: exact resubmission; re-sealed with fresh snapshot and same idempotency key
read/write race: 12 sequential stage toggles vs looping `los inspect unit-os-l02 study-map-os-l02`
docs_consulted: system/OPERATOR.md hard boundary 12 ('On conflict, reload rather than overwrite')
consumer.outcome: Concurrent writers never corrupt or lose anything; each loser is told the state changed and can reload and resubmit.

internal.transaction_behavior: the first writer to take the operator lock commits; others fail the snapshot guard before any canonical write (no journal, no partial file)
internal.approval_behavior: STALE_SNAPSHOT does not consume the idempotency key; the retry changes expected_snapshot, so the approval subject (intent hash) must be recomputed
internal.git_diff_stat: 34 canonical files added (8 inbox captures, 24 receipts, 2 ledgers); curriculum/resume.yaml modified; unit/study-map net status unchanged (last toggle active)

git_status: 35 entries: 34 untracked (inbox + receipts + ledgers) + M curriculum/resume.yaml

friction.description: one repository-wide snapshot guard makes independent writes (two inbox captures and an unrelated stage update) mutually exclusive; each loser needs a fresh snapshot and a recomputed approval hash
friction.cost: 20 of 30 writes refused; 1 extra round-trip each

scenario_record.loser_retry: round 10: exact resubmission → STALE_SNAPSHOT again; re-sealed on fresh snapshot, same idempotency key → committed (130036, 130037)
scenario_record.read_write_race: 12 stage toggles committed sequentially while 24 batch `inspect unit-os-l02 study-map-os-l02` reads ran: 0 errors, 0 torn (unit and map status always agreed; each read carried its own snapshot_id)

uncertainties: Only 3-way races on one machine; lock fairness under heavier contention not measured
The race used back-to-back Popen, not literally `&` in one shell line; start skew was milliseconds
Read/write-race envelopes were written to /tmp and not preserved (the sandbox did not keep them); their results are in evidence/S22/read-write-race.json
